traits.description: Hair dryness without own loci; includes core:androgen with weight -1, sigma_ref is core:androgen's and mean_ref its negation, so G = -G of core:androgen bit for bit (ADR-0034 section 1).

Hair thickness with 2 own additive loci. d_ref 1 per locus, sigma_ref 1 and mean_ref 0 are the exact parameters of the Hardy-Weinberg distribution at p = 0.5 (Var(A) = 2 * 2p(1-p) = 1), an exception to measuring them (ADR-0034 section 1).

loci.description: Additive locus 1 of core:hair_thickness (ADR-0020 section 1, ADR-0034 section 1).
Additive locus 2 of core:hair_thickness (ADR-0020 section 1, ADR-0034 section 1).
